notes: Measured 172.21 TFLOPS fp16 matrix vs 181.0 derived from spec = 95.1%. The shortfall is CLOCK, not architecture: the implied sustained clock is 1.617 GHz against the 1.7 GHz boost the derivation assumed. The 104 CU x 1024 FLOP/clk arithmetic is CONFIRMED.

Occupancy sweep is FLAT from 104 blocks (416 waves, 1 wave/SIMD) to 3328 blocks: 172.13-172.32 TFLOPS. The matrix cores are ISSUE-limited, not occupancy-limited, so this is a genuine plateau rather than a grid artifact.

Correctness of the measurement itself: the emitted ISA contains exactly UNROLL=8 v_mfma_f32_16x16x16f16 instructions, confirming the timed loop was not optimized away. Operands are register-resident so no memory traffic enters the timed region.

THIS RETIRES THE MIXED-BASIS RIDGE. With both terms measured, the clean ridge is 120.2 FLOP/byte (172.27 TFLOPS / 1433.3 GB/s). The earlier 126.3 divided spec FLOPS by measured bandwidth and was labelled mixed-basis; it is superseded. The spec/spec ridge of 110.5 remains correct on its own basis.

Still does not discriminate the bf16 knee: measured knee is B~96-128 and the measured-basis B* is 120, inside that interval - as were both prior candidates. Narrowing the observed knee would settle it.
